articles.summary:
Trump claims Iran is exploring chemical, biological weapons

US President Donald Trump claimed that Iran is seeking to look into chemical and biological weapons.

Trump said that Tehran was "looking at gases, looking at bio" during an interview with Fox News, without providing evidence to back his claims. 

The American president also said that while he does not believe Iran would launch a possible attack on Washington, he vowed that there would be retaliation if one occurred, saying: "If it does happen, we wipe them out."

Saudi Arabia says danger in Wadi Al Dawasir, As Sulayyil passed after warning issued

Saudi Arabia’s civil defence said that danger in Wadi Al Dawasir and As Sulayyil governorates passed, shortly after it issued alerts over a potential threat. 

They urged residents to follow authorities instructions and avoid gathering and filming.

This brings the number of security alerts in the kingdom within the past few hours to a total of five.

articles.summary: The UN on Wednesday warned that an Israeli military offensive in central Gaza could displace more than 18,000 Palestinians and disrupt essential humanitarian services, Anadolu reports. UN deputy spokesman Farhan Haq told reporters that the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs reported Palestinians fleeing the affected area in Deir al-Balah, moving west and southwest earlier Wednesday. “Initial analysis suggests that more than 18,000 people were staying in the affected area, which spans about 2.5 square kilometers (1 square mile). articles.summary: Leaders of Israel’s change bloc said Wednesday that replacing caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu as soon as possible was their “highest priority” as efforts continued to form a new government, Anadolu reports. Gadi Eisenkot, who has been tasked with forming the government, met with Yair Golan, Naftali Bennett, Avigdor Lieberman and Yair Lapid to review progress in coalition negotiations, Israel’s Channel 12 reported, citing a joint statement. “All party leaders agree that their highest priority is to form a national emergency government led by Gadi Eisenkot and to replace Benjamin Netanyahu as prime minister as soon as possible,” the statement said. The leaders also discussed their use of a parliamentary majority in the Knesset, citing the election of lawmaker Matan […]

articles.title: Syria remains ‘committed’ to security understanding with Israel, revival of 1974 disengagement deal: Foreign minister
articles.summary: Syrian Foreign Minister Asaad al-Shaibani said Wednesday that Damascus is “committed” to reaching a security understanding with Israel and reactivating the 1974 Disengagement Agreement amid continued Israeli attacks and incursions into Syrian territory, according to the Alikhbaria state broadcaster, Anadolu reports. Shaibani spoke at a closed session on the sidelines of the Schuman Security and Defence Forum in Brussels, where he said Syria “remains committed to reaching a security understanding with Israel, reactivating the 1974 disengagement agreement and deploying the UN Disengagement Observer Force (UNDOF) to maintain stability.” He said Syria had been subjected to more than 1,000 Israeli airstrikes since the fall of Bashar al-Assad’s regime in December 2024. Shaibani said Israel had occupied additional territory in southern Syria […]

archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, further US and allied responses to the Gulf attacks are expected, alongside intensified diplomatic and sanction pressures on both Israel and Iran.

archive.security_status_cs: Bezpečnostní situace v regionu se nadále vyostřuje v důsledku obnovených pozemních operací v Gaze, rostoucího napětí na Západním břehu a přímých vojenských střetů mezi USA, spojenci a Íránem v Perském zálivu. Izraelský premiér navíc tlačí na USA ohledně potenciální úderné kampaně proti Íránu, což dramaticky zvyšuje riziko širší eskalace.
archive.security_status_en: The regional security situation continues to deteriorate sharply due to renewed ground operations in Gaza, rising tensions in the West Bank, and direct military clashes involving the US, allies, and Iran in the Persian Gulf. Additionally, Israeli leadership is reportedly pressing the US for a potential strike campaign against Iran, dramatically raising the risk of broader escalation.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat další reakce na střety v Perském zálivu a zesílení diplomatických i bezpečnostních opatření ohledně íránského jaderného a zbrojního programu. Konflikt v Gaze a na Západním břehu bude nadále zatěžovat regionální stabilitu.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, further responses to the Persian Gulf clashes and intensified diplomatic and security pressure regarding Iran's weapons programs are expected. The conflict in Gaza and the West Bank will continue to strain regional stability.
